I am an old man with little schooling, so I farm the way my father taught me and the way the extension worker advised. This plot is small, only 0.11 hectares, so my family can manage the work ourselves without hiring help. I will put some cow manure on the soil like I always do, and I will also buy a small bag of chemical fertilizer from the cooperative because the extension man says it helps the maize grow tall. I will plant the improved seed I saved from last year, but I will pull the weeds with my hands and my sons because buying spray is too expensive for such a small piece of land, and we have no water for irrigation here.
